subtitle: Siege on the Hill, City in the Plain

panels.shot: epic split-composition, half showing a fortified hill rising over forests, half a gridded city below with walls and stepwells
panels.action: Mahmud Begada stands on the plain pointing his sword toward the steep Pavagadh hill where Patai Rawal watches from battlements, while below, the ghostly outline of a new walled Champaner city seems to emerge from the earth.

dialogue.text: On a rocky hill held by Patai Rawal, Sultan Mahmud Begada fought a long siege, then raised a new capital below—Champaner, where one conquest became both an ending and a beginning.

i18n.hi: पथरीली पहाड़ी पर पाताई रावल डटा था; सुल्तान महमूद बेगड़ा ने लंबा घेरा डाला, फिर नीचे नई राजधानी उठाई—चाँपानेर, जहाँ एक जीत ही अंत भी बनी, शुरुआत भी

panels.shot: wide aerial panorama of eastern Gujarat, with trade routes threading through plains to a lone hill-fort
panels.action: Dusty trade caravans wind across the plains toward a rugged, red-streaked hill crowned with walls and towers, while distant rivers glint in the light.

dialogue.text: Before the siege, Pavagadh’s hill-fort watched the trade routes of eastern Gujarat, its Rajput rulers taxing caravans and guarding passes between the plains and the plateau.

i18n.hi: घेराबंदी से पहले, पावागढ़ का दुर्ग पूर्वी गुजरात की राहों पर नजर रखता, राजपूत शासक काफिलों से लगान लेते और मैदानी रास्तों व पठारी दर्रों की रखवाली करते

panels.shot: medium interior court scene inside the hill-fort, low-angle on Patai Rawal among his nobles
panels.action: Patai Rawal sits on a stone-backed seat in a courtyard framed by older temples and walls, Rajput nobles around him as they listen to a scout reporting from the plains.

dialogue.text: Rajput chiefs, later named in the Gujarat chronicles as Patai Rawal or Jayasimha, held Pavagadh, drawing strength from its steep sides and old sacred sites along the hill.

i18n.hi: गुजरात के इतिहासों में पाताई रावल या जयसिंह कहे गए राजपूत सरदार पावागढ़ थामे बैठे थे, ताकत उन तीखी ढलानों और पहाड़ी की पुरानी पवित्र जगहों से खींचते

panels.shot: close, three-quarter view of Mahmud Begada in his court at Ahmadabad, with maps and advisors
panels.action: Mahmud Begada stands over a spread-out map in his palace, advisors around him, as he traces a route from Ahmadabad toward Pavagadh with a jewelled finger.

dialogue.text: In Ahmadabad, Sultan Mahmud Shah, called Begada by later writers, watched those same routes, seeing in Pavagadh not just a hill-fort, but the key to the east of his Gujarat Sultanate.

i18n.hi: अहमदाबाद में सुल्तान महमूद शाह, जिसे बाद के लेखक बेगड़ा कहते हैं, वही राहें देख रहा था; उसे पावागढ़ महज़ दुर्ग नहीं, गुजरात सल्तनत के पूरब की चाबी लगा

panels.shot: low-angle wide of Mahmud’s army assembling, banners in wind, with Pavagadh faint on the horizon
panels.action: Rows of armoured soldiers, war elephants, and artillery carts muster outside Ahmadabad as Mahmud Begada mounted on a horse looks east toward the faint outline of Pavagadh.

dialogue.text: The Gujarat chronicler Sikandar ibn Muhammad Manjhu writes in the Mirat-i-Sikandari that Mahmud moved with a great host against Pavagadh, determined to break its resistance and extend his rule.

i18n.hi: गुजरात के इतिहासकार सिकंदर इब्न मुहम्मद मंज़हू मिरात-ए-सिकंदरी में लिखता है कि महमूद विशाल लश्कर के साथ पावागढ़ पर चढ़ आया, किला तोड़कर अपना हुक्म बढ़ाने को अडिग

panels.shot: steep upward shot from the base of Pavagadh, showing scaling ladders failing against high walls
panels.action: Gujarat troops strain with ladders at the base of the hill while high above, Patai Rawal’s defenders stand watch on the bastions, rocks and logs ready to be hurled down.

dialogue.text: Mirat-i-Sikandari and Mirat-i-Ahmadi both speak of a long siege: the slopes were high, the walls strong, and each assault up the stony flanks met with defenders who knew every crag.

i18n.hi: मिरात-ए-सिकंदरी और मिरात-ए-अहमदी दोनों लंबे घेराव का ज़िक्र करते हैं: ऊँची ढलानें, मजबूत फصیلें, और हर चढ़ाई पर पत्थरीली ढालों को ज़ुबानी जानने वाले रक्षक

panels.shot: mid-shot of Mahmud in a field tent at night, candlelight on his face, listening to engineers
panels.action: Inside a lamplit command tent at the foot of the hill, Mahmud Begada listens gravely to engineers and officers pointing to sketches of trenches and artillery placements.

dialogue.speaker: mahmud_begada_and_patai_rawal
dialogue.text: If the hill cannot be climbed, then we will choke its breath.

i18n.hi: जब पहाड़ी नहीं चढ़ेगी, तो उसकी साँस ही रोक देंगे

panels.shot: broad view of siege works encircling the hill, with trenches, earthen ramps, and camps
panels.action: A ring of siege camps, trenches, and earthen batteries now surround Pavagadh; smoke rises from campfires as narrow paths up the slopes are blocked with guards and watch posts.

dialogue.text: The chroniclers describe the siege tightening: trenches and outworks crept closer, supplies in the fort grew scarce, and the once-open hill stood isolated above a plain of enemy tents.

i18n.hi: इतिहासों में घेराव का शिकंजा कसता दिखता है: खंदकें और बाहरी मोर्चे क़िले के पास सरकते गए, अंदर रसद घटती गई, और कभी खुली पहाड़ी अब दुश्मन के डेरों से घिरी अकेली खड़ी थी

panels.shot: contrasting split-panel: left shows starving civilians in fort, right shows disciplined sultanate camp
panels.action: On one side, people within Pavagadh share thin gruel under weathered arches; on the other, Mahmud’s officers inspect grain stores and lines of pack animals in an orderly camp.

dialogue.text: Inside, hunger and strain mounted. Outside, the Sultan’s supply lines kept his army steady. Time itself became a weapon, grinding down defenders who could not descend without battle.

i18n.hi: भीतर भूख और थकान बढ़ती गई; बाहर सुल्तान की रसद ने फौज को मज़बूत रखा; वक़्त खुद हथियार बन गया, उन रक्षकों को घिसता जो बिना लड़ाई नीचे उतर नहीं सकते थे

panels.shot: dramatic low-angle from within the fort gate as it is finally opened to advancing troops
panels.action: Massive wooden gates at the top of the ascent stand ajar as armoured Gujarat soldiers advance cautiously through, while Patai Rawal’s remaining warriors watch grimly from inner walls.

dialogue.text: After months of pressure—later accounts differ on the exact length—the fort’s outer defenses failed. The sources agree on the outcome: Pavagadh fell, and Mahmud’s men entered the hill-fort.

i18n.hi: कई महीनों के दबाव के बाद—बाद के बयान अलग-अलग हैं—किले की बाहरी रक्षा ढह गई; सभी सूत्र नतीजे पर सहमत हैं: पावागढ़ टूटा, और महमूद की फौज दुर्ग में घुस आई

panels.shot: intense mid-shot in a stone hall, Mahmud and Patai facing each other under heavy silence
panels.action: In a stark stone hall within Pavagadh, Mahmud Begada stands flanked by guards while Patai Rawal, hands bound but head unbowed, faces him with a steady gaze.

dialogue.text: Mirat-i-Sikandari relates that the captured Rajput ruler, named Patai Rawal or Jayasimha, was offered Islam and refused, and that he was then put to death on the Sultan’s orders.

i18n.hi: मिरात-ए-सिकंदरी बताती है कि पकड़े गए राजपूत शासक, जिन्हें पाताई रावल या जयसिंह कहा, को इस्लाम की दावत दी गई; उसने इंकार किया, और सुल्तान के हुक्म पर उसे मार दिया गया

panels.shot: somber, respectful wide shot of Patai being led away, Mahmud turned toward the window and the plain
panels.action: Guards lead Patai Rawal away down a corridor while Mahmud stands at an open arch looking out over the plains below, his face unreadable in the fading light.

dialogue.speaker: mahmud_begada_and_patai_rawal
dialogue.text: A hill is taken. But what shall rise from its shadow?

i18n.hi: पहाड़ी जीती गई। अब उसकी परछाईं से क्या उठेगा?

panels.shot: expansive view from the hilltop down to the plain where surveyors and builders mark lines
panels.action: From the edge of Pavagadh’s heights, we see teams of surveyors, soldiers, and craftsmen on the plain below, laying ropes and stakes to mark out the future city of Champaner.

dialogue.text: With the fort secured, Mahmud turned downward, not homeward. The eastern slope and the old settlement of Champaner below would now be reshaped into a new seat of power.

i18n.hi: किला काबू में आते ही महमूद ऊपर से नहीं, नीचे मुड़ा; पूर्वी ढलान और नीचे का पुराना चाँपानेर अब नई गद्दी की शक्ल में ढाला जाने वाला था

panels.shot: ground-level wide shot of walls rising around Champaner, with masons and labourers at work
panels.action: Massive stone blocks are hauled into place as new walls rise around Champaner; masons chisel, labourers haul, and supervisors point, while the outline of bastions begins to take form.

dialogue.text: Ali Muhammad Khan’s Mirat-i-Ahmadi speaks of Mahmud naming the expanded town Muhammadabad-Champaner, encircling it with fortifications and gates to guard the routes he had fought to control.

i18n.hi: अली मुहम्मद ख़ाँ की मिरात-ए-अहमदी लिखती है कि महमूद ने फैलते शहर को मुहम्मदाबाद-चाँपानेर नाम दिया, उसे किलों और दरवाज़ों से घेरा, ताकि वही राहें अब उसकी निगरानी में रहें

panels.shot: high, slightly tilted view of a new Friday mosque rising, with older shrines visible on the hill behind
panels.action: Under scaffolding, arches and domes of a grand mosque take shape in Champaner, while in the background the old temples and paths of Pavagadh cling to the upper hill.

dialogue.text: Archaeology at Champaner-Pavagadh reveals layers: pre-Sultanate shrines and paths on the hill, and below them Mahmud’s period of mosques, gateways and palaces woven into the older landscape.

i18n.hi: चाँपानेर-पावागढ़ की खुदाइयाँ परतें खोलती हैं: पहाड़ी पर सल्तनती दौर से पहले के देवस्थल और पगडंडियाँ, और उनके नीचे–ऊपर महमूद के ज़माने की मस्जिदें, फाटक और महल, जो पुराने मंजर में बुने गए

panels.shot: detailed mid-shot of a stepped tank being constructed, with channels bringing water from the hill
panels.action: Workers carve steps into a large square tank while channels carry water down from Pavagadh’s slopes, filling the reservoir as overseers test the flow with cupped hands.

dialogue.text: The UNESCO dossier and architectural studies describe stepwells, tanks and channels planned to catch hill streams, turning the new capital into a city of managed water in a dry region.

i18n.hi: यूनेस्को के दस्तावेज़ और इमारती अध्ययन सीढ़ीनुमा कुओं, तालाबों और नालों का ज़िक्र करते हैं, जो पहाड़ी की धाराएँ थामने को रचे गए, नई राजधानी को सूखे इलाके में पानी सँभालने वाला शहर बनाते

panels.shot: busy street-level shot within Muhammadabad-Champaner, merchants, soldiers, and artisans in a fortified bazaar
panels.action: Inside the fortified city, traders lead pack animals through a bustling bazaar lined with arcades, while soldiers patrol and artisans work under the shelter of new stone colonnades.

dialogue.text: From its gates, roads led to Malwa, to the interior of Gujarat, and toward the sea. Trade and tax, not just victory, now flowed through the capital Mahmud had hewn from a conquered frontier.

i18n.hi: इसके दरवाज़ों से राहें मलवा, गुजरात के भीतरी इलाकों और समंदर की ओर जाती थीं; अब सिर्फ जीत नहीं, सौदागर और महसूल भी उसी राजधानी से गुज़रते, जो महमूद ने जीती हुई सरहद से गढ़ी

panels.shot: quiet contemplative shot of Mahmud in an upper chamber of a Champaner palace, hill in the distance
panels.action: Mahmud Begada stands alone at a jharokha of a new palace in Champaner, looking toward the looming shape of Pavagadh, its temples and fort walls silhouetted against the sky.

dialogue.text: In the chronicles, Mahmud’s Champaner years mark the height of Gujarat’s courtly splendour. Yet every view from his palace carried the outline of the hill where Patai Rawal had once stood.

i18n.hi: इतिहासों में महमूद के चाँपानेर के साल गुजरात दरबार की शान की चोटी माने जाते हैं; पर उसके महल की हर खिड़की से वही पहाड़ी दिखती थी, जहाँ कभी पाताई रावल खड़ा था

panels.shot: present-day wide aerial of Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park, ruins and surviving structures amid greenery
panels.action: Ruined walls, silent mosques, stepwells filled with still water, and the ancient paths up Pavagadh lie together under a green canopy, the shapes of city and hill still clear from above.

dialogue.text: Today Champaner-Pavagadh’s stones remember both a Rajput court that ended and a Sultanate capital that rose, showing how, in one siege, power could destroy a hill-fort and design an entire city.

i18n.hi: आज चाँपानेर-पावागढ़ की पत्थरें उस राजपूत दरबार को भी याद रखती हैं जो मिटा, और उस सल्तनती राजधानी को भी जो उठी, दिखाते हुए कि एक ही घेराव में ताकत कैसे पहाड़ी दुर्ग तोड़कर पूरी नई नगरी रच सकती है

title_i18n.en: Champaner and the Hill That Became a Capital
title_i18n.hi: चाँपानेर और वह पहाड़ी जो राजधानी बनी

subtitle_i18n.en: Siege on the Hill, City in the Plain
